column1: Yes, I've brought the evidence that Judge Palmer asked me to bring. Please let me in to see him!
column2: 是的，我帶來了 Palmer 法官要求的證物。請讓我進去見他！

column1: I'm sorry, Detective Bonds, court is in session at this time, and the Judge's docket is quite full. Perhaps you could try another time.
column2: 抱歉，Bonds 探員，目前正在開庭，法官的庭期也排得很滿。也許你可以改天再來。

column1: This is extremely urgent. I need to obtain a "No Bail Warrant" for the Hoffman case immediately. Every minute counts. If I don't get this over there quickly, he'll walk and that's the last we'll see of him. Please tell the Judge now, or there's going to be hell to pay.
column2: 這非常緊急。我必須立即取得 Hoffman 案的「不得交保令」。分秒必爭；如果不能快點送過去，他就會被放走，我們再也抓不到他。請現在就告訴法官，否則後果不堪設想。

column1: I would dearly love to grant your Warrant and keep this suspect off the streets, but there just isn't enough evidence here. Perhaps if you brought me something else, I could help you. I am sincerely sorry, Detective. Here's your evidence.
column2: 我很想核發令狀、讓這名嫌犯不能回到街上，但這裡的證物實在不夠。也許你再帶些別的東西來，我就能幫忙。我真的很抱歉，探員。這是你的證物。

column1: My pleasure. Here's your evidence and your warrant.
column2: 不客氣。這是你的證物和令狀。

column1: No, but YOU will if you spend so much time in here that Hoffman's lawyer has released him by the time you get back to the jailhouse. Move it, Detective.
column2: 不會，但如果你在這裡耗太久，等你回到拘留所時 Hoffman 的律師已經把他弄出去了，那你就會。快走，探員。

column1: Believe me when I say I'd love to give you a warrant for this suspect, but there's not enough evidence to support it. If you could provide me with something else, I could probably issue one. Sorry, Detective.
column2: 相信我，我很想替這名嫌犯核發令狀，但證物不足以支持它。如果你能提供其他東西，我大概就能核發。抱歉，探員。

column1: Here's your evidence and your Warrant, Detective. Now get your butt down to the jail and keep that bird from flying!
column2: 這是你的證物和令狀，探員。現在快到拘留所去，別讓那隻鳥飛走！

column1: Your honor, I'm Acting Detective Sonny Bonds. I'm sorry to disturb you like this, but it's most urgent that I get a No Bail Warrant for one of my prisoners, Marvin Hoffman.
column2: 法官大人，我是代理探員 Sonny Bonds。很抱歉這樣打擾您，但我必須緊急為我的囚犯 Marvin Hoffman 取得不得交保令。

column1: Fascinating. You have any evidence to back this up?
column2: 有意思。你有證物支持這個說法嗎？

column1: Detective Bonds! Did you bring me more evidence?
column2: Bonds 探員！你帶來更多證物了嗎？

column1: Then I'll hold you in contempt of court and throw your overpriced butt in jail for a week, and THEN I'll have you disbarred.
column2: 那我就以藐視法庭罪判你入獄一週，然後吊銷你的執照。

column1: As for you, Mister, I highly suggest you review your rules of evidence before you appear in this courtroom again.
column2: 至於你，我強烈建議你下次再出現在這間法庭前，先複習證據規則。

column1: You give the evidence to the bailiff.
